positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
Designing, developing, implementing, supporting and maintaining software development projects through the use of the Microsoft .NET technologies. 
Use of SCRUM methodology. 

Technologies used: 

UI development ( HTML, CSS, Javascript, jQuery, ajax, json, angularjs, typescript, bootstrap) 
Asp .Net (C#, WebForms, MVC 4-5, Web API 2, EF) 
SQL Server (Transact-SQL) 
Windows Communication Foundation WCF 
Automated Tests with Selenium

Contractor for Symantec. Supporting one of their applications. It is called AdvisorMail.
It is an email archiving and compliance solution.
I started as a backup developer, now I am in charge of all development activities for this solution

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for setting up servers with CentOS, MySQL, Apache and Postgresql services.
* Responsible for maintaining/repairing MySQL and Postgresql databases.
* Responsible for maintaining/repairing systems based on python, xml and postgres technologies.
* Users Management.
* Build web services to communicate different platforms and technologies (working team with third parties).
* Developement in PHP with MVC patron.
o Functional experience: Define functional specifications,
o Tools: CodeIgniter, jQuery, PHP, Postgresql, SOAP webservices.

company.name: Subdirección de Ingresos del Estado Morelia

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
In order to get degree as Computer System Engineer, It was required to present a Technical Report and oral exam of the following project:
•	Analyzing, Designing, Developing, Testing, and implementing a property system for the Systems and Computer Department.
•	Create a tool used to track student’s internship.
•	Applying new concept called Intelligence Office to reduce cost and resources.
•	Create several report screens.
•	Use SCRUM approach methodology.
•	Create manuals and documentation of the whole development process.

•	Technologies used:
o	PHP, CodeIgniter (PHP Framework, MVC patron)
o	HTML, CSS, Javascript(jQuery, ajax, json, RGraph)
o	MySQL (Transact-SQL)
